sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Sentinel: Stoic Protector'''' possesses the Stoneshield power which makes it the perfect [[Titan]] to take out smaller heroes. An opposing group will need five attacks to defeat it! Sentinel is a great Titan to play with defensive Combat Action cards like [[TCG:SAS-098|Boltflare]] and [[TCG:SAS-099|Honorguard]] as Sentinel becomes a one-Titan wall!
